sources.label: Apyx reserve and non-reserve accounting definitions
Wolf August 2026 securities examination, signed September 11

reserveReview.rationale: Issuer documentation classifies Inventory and Protocol Owned Liquidity as non-reserve, nonredeemable self-issued claims. Gross reserves of $307,593,129.35 less Inventory of $61,062,157.37285687 and POL of $53,894,639.55179605 give $192,636,332.42534712 in external reserves. API supply of $307,573,514.82 less the same own claims gives $192,616,717.8953471 in redeemable claims; the derived ratio of 1.0001018319 matches the reported 1.000102. This reserve accounting does not modify public circulating supply. External STRC/STRCx exposure is 86.74094097%, Cash & Equivalents is 13.25535639%, and Other is 0.00370265%; live one-decimal output rounds to 86.7% and 13.3%. Cash remains conservative because issuer documentation includes lending and liquidity positions. The Wolf August opinion, signed September 11, examines securities as of August 13 and August 31. August 31 holdings include $66,363,383 in brokerage STRC/SATA and $102,095,394 in self-custodied STRCx. The opinion does not reconcile all cash, reserves, or liabilities.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable timestamp 1789502434250; exclude issuer-documented nonredeemable Inventory and POL from both gross asset and claim totals; classify the resulting external reserve mix
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Cash & Equivalents combines cash, stablecoins, Treasury bills and deployed DeFi positions without weights; STRC combines direct shares with STRCx without current weights; Other is 0.00370265% and below live one-decimal slice precision. Gross own claims remain separately reconciled in live metadata. Wolf examines securities only, not complete reserves or redeemable liabilities.
